name: io.github.Medxpert-org/ubic-governance-mcp
title: SynomosAI Governance MCP
description: AI governance MCP: A3 scorecard, ISO 42001 evidence templates, compliance checklist, gov_scan.

environmentVariables.name: SYNOSMOSAI_REQUIRE_VISA
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a visa JSON file. When set, every tools/call must present an active, unexpired visa; unset by default, in which case the gate is off.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scope_note: Outputs are self-assessment and evidence artifacts; they are not third-party certification or legal advice. The optional visa gate is off unless SYNOSMOSAI_REQUIRE_VISA is set.
